<action>
{"tool": "bash", "input": {"command": "cd /tmp && rm -rf ptest && mkdir ptest && cd ptest
cp $(pwd 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null
# find actual workspace dir
WS="$(dirname "$(find / -name vuln.c 2>/dev/null | head -1)")"
echo "WS=$WS"
ls -la "$WS"
cd "$WS"
cc -O0 -o /tmp/ptest/vuln vuln.c
cd "$WS"
cd /tmp/ptest
cc -O0 -o /tmp/ptest/vuln "$WS/vuln.c"
cc -O0 -o /tmp/ptest/fixed "$WS/fixed.c"
echo "compiled:"; ls -la
# Build candidate files of various sizes
d=files; mkdir -p $d
for sz in 0 1 63 64 65 100 999 1000 1001 4096 65536; do
  head -c $sz /dev/zero > $d/sz_$sz
  echo -n "size $sz: vuln="; ./vuln $d/sz_$sz >/dev/null 2>&1; echo -n $?; echo -n " fixed="; ./fixed $d/sz_$sz >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?
done"}}
</action>

<action>
{"tool": "bash", "input": {"command": "cd /tmp/ptest
# Special files: infinite stream, /proc, directory, fifo, missing
for f in /dev/zero /dev/random /dev/urandom /proc/self/mem /proc/self/stat /proc/net/dev . files /nonexistent_file_xyz; do
  echo -n "$f : vuln="; timeout 2 ./vuln "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo -n $?; echo -n " fixed="; timeout 2 ./fixed "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?
done
# FIFO test
mkfifo myfifo 2>/dev/null
echo -n "fifo(no writer) : vuln="; timeout 2 ./vuln myfifo >/dev/null 2>&1; echo -n $?; echo -n " fixed="; timeout 2 ./fixed myfifo >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?
# fifo with data
( printf 'hello' > myfifo ) &
echo -n "fifo(5B) : vuln="; timeout 2 ./vuln myfifo >/dev/null 2>&1; echo -n $?; echo -n " fixed="; timeout 2 ./fixed myfifo >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?"}}
</action>
